title: Products
formDescription: Enter the product's details, variants, prices and barcodes.
editDescription: Change the details and save. Cost is updated only by receiving stock.
readOnlyHint: Editing products requires the catalog edit permission.
noTaxClassesHint: Create a tax class in Settings before adding products.
emptyDescription: Add your first product to get started.
emptyFilteredDescription: Try changing the search or filters.
name: Name
variantCount: {count, plural, =0 {No variants} one {# variant} other {# variants}}
archiveConfirm: Archive “{name}”? It will stop appearing at the register; its history is kept.
unitWeighedHint: Sold by weight or measure. Enter the price per 1 unit.
pricesIncludeTaxHint: The price you enter already includes VAT.
trackStockHint: Sales and receiving change the stock level.
activeHint: Inactive products do not appear at the register.
imageHint: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 2 MB.
imageFailed: The product was saved but its image could not be uploaded. Please try again.
optionsHint: Add options such as size or color; every combination of values becomes a variant (up to 3 options).
pluHint: Code printed on scale labels, up to 7 digits.
openingCostHint: New variants only. Receiving stock updates it afterwards.
barcodeScanHint: Scan a barcode, or type it and press Enter
